bless-you/a-new-york-home.description: A rectangular yellow light brightens and fades behind a house at dusk.
bless-you/a-new-york-home.excerpt:
This is an invisible home.
In the city, it stands briefly,

bless-you/behind-my-mind.description: Aurora curtains rippling over a still fjord, a cabin lit on the shore.
bless-you/behind-my-mind.excerpt:
Still, you wave from where you stand,
Your eyes fixed past me, their light no longer gleams.

bless-you/beloved.description: A golden silhouette, with a point of light at the heart that blooms and recedes.
bless-you/beloved.excerpt:
The lingering love,
flowing endlessly where hope slowly descends.

bless-you/crown-antiques.description: Dusty antique-shop glazing, blue-green square tiles, stacked records and boxes; motes fall through light on both sides of the glass.

bless-you/cube.description: A matte grayscale cube turns with a few tiny coloured flecks fixed to its faces. Near the midpoint, the triangular cut catches white light.
bless-you/cube.excerpt:
I've told you more than once,
you will never become a ball.

bless-you/dancing-children.description: The three painted children and skateboard sit on a modernist ceramic facade. A soft daylight reflection travels across the glazed wall.
bless-you/dancing-children.excerpt:
I only saw children dancing,
No children dance. Until I leave.

bless-you/drowned-spirit.description: An empty riverside bench, rippling city reflections and a fading sunset; blue hour arrives as window and shore lights gradually brighten.
bless-you/drowned-spirit.excerpt:
At the bottom of the river, you,
Were replaced by someone's spirit.

bless-you/ears.description: Braided threads form an ear. The outer helix and inner folds expand and draw together in a paired heartbeat.
bless-you/ears.excerpt: Oh, young ears, what sounds can you perceive that I cannot?

bless-you/feet.description: Snow peaks catching first light above a still, misty mountain lake.
bless-you/feet.excerpt:
Replacing street lights' gleam,
In bridge tunnels where snow convince.

bless-you/flying-away.description: A sparrow grips a sagging wire in the blue morning. It crouches, pushes off and flies behind the edge of the café window.
bless-you/flying-away.excerpt: On the power line outside, a bird rests still,

bless-you/gentleness.description: Dusk aarti on the ganga, lamps on the steps and diyas on the water.
bless-you/gentleness.excerpt:
A gentle breeze comes softly, brushing past my ears,
It brings sunlight, filtering through my eyes.

bless-you/how.description: Sunset on lake pichola, udaipur's palaces glowing over the water.
bless-you/how.excerpt:
The heart's pulse, emotions flowing,
Watching sunlight reflect on waves.

bless-you/in-the-sunlight.description: The earth rising over a cratered lunar horizon in long low sunlight.
bless-you/in-the-sunlight.excerpt:
Awaiting sunlight's touch, where children stay and play.
Shadows retreat as moments hold their way,

bless-you/kite.description: Pine ridges fading into morning fog, sunbeams slanting through.
bless-you/kite.excerpt:
Your figure shows then fade,
During the night.

bless-you/milk-cow-cat.description: A black-and-white cat sleeps on a four-pane windowsill as city lights flicker and a plane passes behind the window frame.
bless-you/milk-cow-cat.excerpt:
Beneath night's smell,
through window walls, four squares,
My mind painted a bright cow standing there.

bless-you/missing.description: Two cups stand across a table. A sheer curtain falls back toward an ordinary window, revealing a blue coat on the empty chair.
bless-you/missing.excerpt: Dedicated to the clearest eyes under the sun,

bless-you/perplexity.description: A forest-green lake and narrow waterfall lie under jagged snowy mountains and high clouds.
bless-you/perplexity.excerpt:
Telling children tales of skies up high to the hill.
"Will I become a cloud when I am gone?"

bless-you/river.description: The taj mahal at sunrise, mirrored in its pool through morning haze.
bless-you/river.excerpt:
Within the pen, You are ever mine.
Dream a diver, on a noiseless land,

bless-you/silver-tipped-shoes.description: Silver snow ridges and one sharp ice facet rise over a dark blue mirror lake under a pale moon.
bless-you/silver-tipped-shoes.excerpt:
Silver-tipped shoes, shiny and bright,
Catch my eyes with their gleaming light.

bless-you/symphony.description: Moonlight glints on a quiet river below a stone bridge, between shadowed trees and distant houses.
bless-you/symphony.excerpt:
Walking through the night,
Listening to symphonies played by moonlight.

bless-you/telecine.description: The vercel triangle over a mirror of salt, the sun rising behind its tip.
bless-you/telecine.excerpt:
Unable to pick up flowers and wine,
The pen I put down now turns into your food.

bless-you/the-absurd.description: The sun sets past a pine headland, lit cloud, glitter on rolling sea.
bless-you/the-absurd.excerpt:
Dancing, she dances, is the absurd, the absurd and more,
Like clouds your polished mind changes shape forevermore.

bless-you/the-only.description: A wall of lava lamps under the glowing orange cloud, watched by a camera.
bless-you/the-only.excerpt:
It is the distant light on the edge of the building,
Something we can only imagine but don't know the name of,

bless-you/today.description: Light shafts, swaying kelp and a turning school of fish over a reef.
bless-you/today.excerpt:
While shrimp floats in the sink below,
just a fork needed till dawn's light is thrown.

bless-you/traces-of-healing.description: Light shafts, swaying kelp and a turning school of fish over a reef.
bless-you/traces-of-healing.excerpt:
I see what little green remains, dwells,
Lingering between the broken steps of the church,

bless-you/unworthy.description: Amer fort floodlit gold on its hill, mirrored in maota lake at night.
bless-you/unworthy.excerpt: My worth and my value—how would I be aware?

bless-you/wandering.description: The vercel triangle over a mirror of salt, the sun rising behind its tip.
bless-you/wandering.excerpt:
In silent rooms where words remain spoken,
The kitten bites the mouse, hunger awoken.

bless-you/young-blood.description: A volcano erupting at night, lava rivers, an ash plume full of lightning.
bless-you/young-blood.excerpt:
To be infused by your stale demands, decayed,
Into the blood of the young, to keep outdated ideologies burning,

still-life/a-flowing-song.description: The milky way over a lone acacia on moonless dunes, meteors falling.
still-life/a-flowing-song.excerpt:
Rain and people were both tangled in the moon.
I don’t understand,

still-life/after-snow.description: Snow drifts past a blue mountain valley. Mist pulls away from the rooftops and warm windows appear on the hillside.
still-life/after-snow.excerpt:
I watch the city shrouded in the mist,
From mountains. Lights dance and persist.

still-life/afternoon-nap.description: Udaipur at night, a lit gateway on lake pichola and diyas on the water.
still-life/afternoon-nap.excerpt:
A few hours, or perhaps until dusk,
I woke to the aroma of dinner,

still-life/black-paint.description: A dark painted mask rests on stretched white canvas. Raking light reveals raised cracks, translucent flakes and dark-brown paint.
still-life/black-paint.excerpt: I observe the cracks where paint has dried upon the mask,

still-life/boring-clouds.description: Tree trunks race across a dark railway window. Distant cumulus holds its shape while a thinner veil and sunlit mist grains drift across the undersides.
still-life/boring-clouds.excerpt:
The train rushes past a curtain of trees,
A house appears, then vanishes in seconds.

still-life/breathe-away.description: A black spire and an orange cloud over a blue hour city and its river.
still-life/breathe-away.excerpt:
Watching footsteps beyond the wall.
White goose rise with wings spread wild,

still-life/church.description: A white chapel under a blue sky as the grass gives way to snow.
still-life/church.excerpt: Sunlight shouldn’t exist here; my mind seemed increasingly sluggish. My gaze lingered on the faintly emerging statue at the end of the church, a grayish-white silhouette.

still-life/coin.description: An embossed brass coin bounces once on the paving, rolls on its rim and tips onto its face.
still-life/coin.excerpt: In the moment when the coin is tossed,

still-life/dusk.description: Translucent gauze at a bedside window, softly moving leaves and pink-orange light falling across wooden floorboards at dusk.
still-life/dusk.excerpt:
The breeze lifts delicate gauze at bedside,
A blue light enters, tinged with pink and orange hues.

still-life/early-spring.description: Light shafts, swaying kelp and a turning school of fish over a reef.
still-life/early-spring.excerpt:
Like a greeting card printed in gray dust,
playing on the shelves, faded yet stayed.

still-life/feather.description: A white feather falls beside a puddle, settles in wet mud and darkens from the point of contact.
still-life/feather.excerpt:
Gently falling, then mud-stained,
Turning to a dull yellow, at the end,

still-life/ghost.description: A dark planet cut into the planetscale mark, backlit, a moon circling.
still-life/ghost.excerpt:
The prairie, sky, or face in disrepair?
Finally, eyes dissolved in darkness' snare, reveal.

still-life/green-tea.description: The taj mahal at sunrise, mirrored in its pool through morning haze.
still-life/green-tea.excerpt:
I had been eating breakfast for half an hour.
I nodded, then made myself a cup of hot tea,

still-life/how-to-use-an-edible-tomato.description: The vercel triangle over a mirror of salt, the sun rising behind its tip.
still-life/how-to-use-an-edible-tomato.excerpt: For a finer texture, score a cross on top, scald it briefly in hot water, then move it to cold and peel. Once the skin falls away, the tomato looks quieter, treated gently by the world.

still-life/iron-nails.description: One large foreground torii frames a smaller, lower shrine hall at the end of a stone approach, with layered snow mountains behind and no foreground trees.
still-life/iron-nails.excerpt: Trees jutting at angles, green palms nestled between buildings,

still-life/just-a-sign.description: A clear yellow dashed centerline separates the two directions of traffic at dusk. The two white edge lines stay continuous.
still-life/just-a-sign.excerpt: A silent metal witness to the traffic every day

still-life/night-light.description: A lighthouse turning its beam under moonlit clouds over a dark sea.
still-life/night-light.excerpt:
Like a jellyfish drifting through deep sea waters,
Or some self-illuminating creature unnamed,

still-life/photo.description: A desert highway at dusk, rushing toward the mountains and last light.
still-life/photo.excerpt:
weeping in the sunny day, where
watching distant valleys and trains

still-life/platform.description: Dusk aarti on the ganga, lamps on the steps and diyas on the water.
still-life/platform.excerpt:
Midnight blue, Peter River, lightest and mair;
Moon blurs softly, impressions, beyond aware.

still-life/roaring.description: A volcano erupting at night, lava rivers, an ash plume full of lightning.

still-life/sleeping-in.description: A white limestone arcade and courtyard pool under a bright blue sky; a few pink beads drift across blue water beside an empty boat.
still-life/sleeping-in.excerpt:
In lethargy all seems asleep.
The train dormant at its station,

still-life/snowy-county.description: Snow peaks catching first light above a still, misty mountain lake.
still-life/snowy-county.excerpt:
As I walk past, it is white, snowy.
Into every corner of sight,

still-life/stone-frog.description: Two green stone frogs are seen in profile under cherry blossoms. A loose petal turns and settles between their plinths.
still-life/stone-frog.excerpt:
Under the cherry blossoms,
Two stone frogs,

still-life/thermos.description: A worn enamel thermos on a table by a rainy window tilts and pours hot water into the red mug. Steam stays over the cup after the bottle returns to its place.
still-life/thermos.excerpt: But I have no choice, I still need to protect, preserve all their warmth.

still-life/third-three.description: The night earth from orbit, cloudflare requests arcing city to city.
still-life/third-three.excerpt:
While three souls share one dwelling,
It’s the third year in New York City,

still-life/tourist.description: An anvil thunderhead at dusk flickering over a wheat field.
still-life/tourist.excerpt:
Pointing to five in the afternoon. Sunlight through the leaves like strung pearls,
Flickering with the yellow-green light of fireflies, I carry my luggage,

still-life/urban-monologue.description: A night city whose boulevards trace the command key in streetlight.
still-life/urban-monologue.excerpt:
Red, green, yellow, realities we fail to name,
Colors of signals guiding us through streets the same.

still-life/waiting-in-line-in-a-dream.description: Mumbai's queen's necklace at night, lamps curving round the bay.
still-life/waiting-in-line-in-a-dream.excerpt: A twenty-two-year-old man waiting in line in a dream should not, first of all, ask himself where the line leads. That is a question an awake person would ask.

still-life/washing.description: The jaipur water palace floating on a misty lake at sunrise.
still-life/washing.excerpt:
At five, I get up from the boat, washing;
Seven, washing, waking up, washing.

still-life/winter.description: The sun sets past a pine headland, lit cloud, glitter on rolling sea.
still-life/winter.excerpt:
Together on grass, beneath the snow.
Missing you and summer's gentle glow,

still-life/yellow.description: Sunset on lake pichola, udaipur's palaces glowing over the water.
still-life/yellow.excerpt:
Looking back, I see birds by the water,
In the ripples, in the park.

their-world/breakfast.description: Light shafts, swaying kelp and a turning school of fish over a reef.
their-world/breakfast.excerpt:
Seagulls perch on the terrace, watching, waiting.
On the plate, yellow eggs, green avocados,

their-world/candle.description: A candle burns close to the viewer on a dark wooden table. Its small pool of light falls on a charcoal wall, with moonlit water visible in the far window.

their-world/cottage.description: One unbroken view of a timber cottage as afternoon turns to dusk. Wind carries a few leaves across the path. Warmth appears and fades in the two windows while the house remains.
their-world/cottage.excerpt: Grandfather is gone. The cottage remains.

their-world/end-for-the-end.description: The sun sets past a pine headland, lit cloud, glitter on rolling sea.
their-world/end-for-the-end.excerpt:
Hearing the heartbeat, an echo in the vein,
Glass of gloomy night, stranded on the milky shoal, in sweet,

their-world/farewell.description: A desert highway at dusk, rushing toward the mountains and last light.
their-world/farewell.excerpt:
Confined beneath this vast sky,
I, therefore, should begin to say goodbye.

their-world/going-home.description: A vermilion bridge lands on a stone quay beside a warm house, connected to its entrance by a short shore path.
their-world/going-home.excerpt:
They seem to stand in the forest,
Watching me go home, go to school,

their-world/hope.description: Sky lanterns rising over a still mountain lake, one let go from a boat.
their-world/hope.excerpt:
Angels with shining wings light up the sky.
You hear the whispers, you see the tears.

their-world/join-us.description: A tokyo side street in the rain, neon signs shining on the wet road.
their-world/join-us.excerpt: You will see, on street billboards,

their-world/manifesto.description: An ivory CRT on a writing desk. Letters slip inside the glass, gather into a white flame and cast light on the wall.
their-world/manifesto.excerpt: A white flame within the black noise, jumping up and down,

their-world/pockets.description: A dark planet cut into the planetscale mark, backlit, a moon circling.
their-world/pockets.excerpt:
Small birds being caught, tight, hold,
Stuffing all the beauty before sunset, into pockets.

their-world/private-sky.description: A private shopfront and a locked iron gate beneath a still, delicate blue sky; one faint cloud drifts above the public street.
their-world/private-sky.excerpt:
I listen quietly, the gate closes behind.
Standing here, watching the still, delicate blue sky.

their-world/room.description: A night city whose boulevards trace the command key in streetlight.
their-world/room.excerpt:
Idle soul, drifting without purpose,
Barren rooms, no spirits to share this life.

their-world/shadow.description: A person pauses at a stair landing. Two profiles on the warm plaster drift together and resolve into one while the open door holds the blue winter twilight.
their-world/shadow.excerpt:
I look at the shadows' faces, which reflect like mirrors,
and see only my reflection, staring back at me.

their-world/side.description: Sunset on lake pichola, udaipur's palaces glowing over the water.
their-world/side.excerpt:
Joy from the end of time, so beautiful,
Join us, come to the new world.

their-world/siren.description: A volcano erupting at night, lava rivers, an ash plume full of lightning.
their-world/siren.excerpt:
I feel the outdoors, from the dark,
The wind carrying children's dreams, echoes, happiness.

their-world/synesthesia.description: Dusk aarti on the ganga, lamps on the steps and diyas on the water.
their-world/synesthesia.excerpt:
Where do nature’s wandering flavors go?
Rice cake, salt pork, sliced fish face in a line,

their-world/the-age-of-secrets.description: The night earth from orbit, cloudflare requests arcing city to city.
their-world/the-age-of-secrets.excerpt:
In daylight hours filled with tales unplanned,
Leaving us to question if human, we still stand.

their-world/the-barn.description: Grazing cattle, a wooden fence and a distant brick house sit beside a lake under summer clouds.
their-world/the-barn.excerpt:
Hear maturity calling on the plains,
Cows lower their heads, waiting for the train to pass.

their-world/the-observer.description: A warm candlelit dinner inside, with seven black-coated observers barely visible outside a dark night window.
their-world/the-observer.excerpt:
I am the observer, I watch all this happen.
We stand outside the window,

their-world/the-white-tree.description: A white trunk rapidly grows a crown. The crown falls as white grains, and a gust carries the finer grains across the yellow grass.
their-world/the-white-tree.excerpt:
On the yellow fields, alone, stands a white tree.
Leaning against the black mountains,

their-world/the-wrapper.description: Pine ridges fading into morning fog, sunbeams slanting through.
their-world/the-wrapper.excerpt:
Dreams dissolved before it reached the tongue.
What we felt dies when peeled away, that, indispensable sweet,

their-world/trash.description: The sun sinks into a drifting sea of orange cloud at dusk.
their-world/trash.excerpt:
Worn by fingers until colors fade to whispers,
Or scorched by relentless sun until all living traces vanish.

their-world/umbrella.description: The café and rainy street begin in black and white. Yellow drops pass down the café window, leaving wet tracks that gradually join together.
their-world/umbrella.excerpt: You say, what you want to do is protect, not harm.

their-world/window.description: A wall of lava lamps under the glowing orange cloud, watched by a camera.
their-world/window.excerpt:
I can't hear anything outside.
She must be crazy.
